item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
State exco Daniel Gooi says Penang is the only state that has achieved the national ambulance response target, due to community responders. About 58% of its Priority 1 emergency calls this year were responded to within 15 minutes, surpassing the 50% KPI.
